g.text: Throughput against latency, one dot per configuration
4 KiB random reads on a local NVMe drive. Up and left is better
Throughput against latency, one dot per configuration
4 KiB sequential reads. Every backend at every depth lands on the same throughput
p99 latency per read, ms. Readahead serves about 97% of sequential reads from memory, so these are the reads that reached the device
